'''Ralen Margok''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who was a member of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] more than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]]<ref name="Codex" /> before [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> Margok was aboard the pirate [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Aggressor (Rishi)|''Aggressor'']] when it crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], and they were instrumental in converting the vessel into a base of operations for the Blades. As a result, Margok's descendants, including [[Dael Margok]], became major players in the Blades in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] that followed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ralen Margok was mentioned in the Codex entry for his descendant Dael Margok in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
